item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossy)】MP3 - Charli XCX - XCX World [OG Files Mark "Spike" Stent Mix and Masters]
item.description:
Charli XCX - XCX World (fanmade title)
OG FILES FOR MARK SPIKE STENT MIXES

In late August 2017, XCX's Google Drive, where she kept files of songs recorded during the album's sessions, and Spike Stent, who was paid to mix and master 12 album tracks, were the subjects of a hacking attack.[15][16] Although paid to mix and master 12 tracks, Stent only completed 10 by November 2016.[17] All of these leaked in their unmixed and unmastered versions, except for the previously released singles, "After the Afterparty" and "Boys".[18][19][20][21] After being asked if "Bounce" was ever going to be released in September 2017 during an interview with Jake Indiana of Highsnobiety, XCX replied that the studio version would be out soon; however, she was unsure if it would appear on the album, following the leakage.[22] Although in September, XCX still mentioned that the album was going to be released eventually, but Atlantic Records ultimately decided to shelve the record. She then shifted her focus to recording her fourth mixtape, Pop 2 (2017), and her fifth mixtape, which eventually became her eponymous third studio album, Charli(2019).
